[SWS_FrTrcv_00434].⌋
Note that in the time span between power up and the call FrTrcv_Init the FlexRay
transceiver hardware may be in a different state. This depends on hardware and SPAL
driver configuration.
The initialization sequence after reset (e.g. power up) is a critical phase for the FlexRay
transceiver driver.
Note: Before calling FrTrcv_Init the environment insures that all SPAL drivers used by
the FrTrcv module to access the transceiver hardware are initialized and usable.
